title: Add GDPR-safe event tracking, fingerprint-based free limits, and monetization instrumentation

requirements.text: Implement an on-chain events store in the Motoko backend that matches the provided schema semantics for `events` (id, event_name, country, page, device, timestamp, metadata) and can be written without requiring user login.

quotes:
Database table: events
events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  event_name TEXT,
  country TEXT,
  page TEXT,
  device TEXT,
  timestamp DATETIME,
  metadata TEXT
)

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a public shared method to append an event with fields: event_name (Text), country (Text), page (Text), device (Text), metadata (Text), and an optional fingerprint (Text).
Each appended event is assigned a monotonically increasing numeric id and stored with a timestamp taken server-side (Time.now()).
Event storage is persisted across upgrades using stable state.
Appending an event works for anonymous callers (no Internet Identity required).

requirements.text: Add an optional backend `usage_limits` store keyed by `fingerprint` that tracks `invoices_count` and `last_reset` (monthly reset), and provide backend methods to increment/check limits for anonymous users (works without login).

quotes:
Optional table: usage_limits
usage_limits (
  fingerprint TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  invoices_count INTEGER,
  last_reset DATETIME
)

Fingerprint logic (simple & legal):
hash(IP + user_agent + day)
No personal data stored ✔️
GDPR-safe ✔️
Works without login ✔️

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a shared method to get current anonymous usage for a fingerprint (invoices_count for the current month) and a shared method to increment usage for a fingerprint.
Backend resets a fingerprint's invoices_count when a new month starts (based on Time.now() and stored last_reset).
The monthly free limit enforced by this usage store is 5 invoices/month for fingerprints.
Anonymous usage tracking does not store raw IP or raw user agent values in stable state (only the provided fingerprint string, counts, and timestamps).

requirements.text: Add backend query endpoints for admins to analyze performance: list events (with optional filters) and retrieve weekly aggregated counts and the key ratios: free_limit_reached / invoice_previewed, ai_explain_clicked count, stripe_checkout_clicked / upgrade_cta_shown.

quotes:
4️⃣ Metrics That Matter (Germany Focus)
Track weekly:
•	free_limit_reached / invoice_previewed → upgrade pressure
•	ai_explain_clicked → compliance anxiety
•	stripe_checkout_clicked / upgrade_cta_shown → pricing fit

acceptanceCriteria: Admin-only query method exists to list recent events with optional filters for event_name and time range.
Admin-only query method exists that returns aggregated weekly counts for the core event names plus the computed ratios for the specified week (or last N weeks).
Non-admin callers cannot access raw event lists or aggregated analytics (must trap/deny).

requirements.text: Add conditional upgrade migration support for the new persisted `events` and `usage_limits` state so existing deployed state can be upgraded without data loss.
acceptanceCriteria: Project includes an upgrade path that initializes new stable fields for events and usage limits when upgrading from prior versions.
After upgrade, existing features (plans, invoices, Stripe config) continue to function and the canister does not trap during post-upgrade due to missing fields.

requirements.text: Add a frontend event logging utility that can be called from anywhere in the UI to log the Core Events exactly as named (DO NOT rename) along with country, page, device, timestamp, and metadata, and that works for both anonymous and authenticated sessions.

quotes:
Core Events (DO NOT rename — consistency matters)
Action	Event Name
App opened	app_opened
Country detected	country_detected
VAT calculated	vat_calculated
Reverse charge checked	reverse_charge_checked
Invoice previewed	invoice_previewed
Invoice downloaded	invoice_downloaded
AI VAT explanation clicked	ai_explain_clicked
Free limit reached	free_limit_reached
Upgrade CTA shown	upgrade_cta_shown
Stripe checkout clicked	stripe_checkout_clicked
Payment success	payment_success

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend provides a single, reusable function/hook to log an event to the backend actor, including: event_name, country, page, device, metadata, and fingerprint when available.
Event names sent from the frontend match the provided snake_case values exactly.
Logging failures do not break the primary user flow (errors are caught and only logged to console/toast if needed).

requirements.text: Implement the specified fingerprint logic on the frontend and pass only the resulting fingerprint to the backend (no raw IP/user agent storage). Fingerprint must be stable for a given user-agent+IP for the current day and rotate daily.

quotes:
Fingerprint logic (simple & legal):
hash(IP + user_agent + day)
No personal data stored ✔️
GDPR-safe ✔️
Works without login ✔️

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend computes a daily fingerprint as hash(IP + user_agent + day) and sends only the hash to the backend (the app does not persist raw IP or raw user agent as stored tracking data).
Fingerprint value changes when the day changes.
If IP cannot be determined at runtime, the app degrades gracefully (still logs events, but without fingerprint and without anonymous usage enforcement).

requirements.text: Instrument the exact Caffeine AI Logic Flow by logging the specified events at the corresponding user actions/system points: on app load, on country detection, on VAT calculation click, on reverse charge check, on invoice preview, on invoice download attempt/success, on AI VAT explanation click, on upgrade modal shown, on Stripe checkout click, and on payment success.

quotes:
🔹 Caffeine AI Logic Flow (Exact)
🟢 ON APP LOAD
Detect country (IP)
→ log event: app_opened
→ log event: country_detected (metadata: DE)
...
🧮 VAT CALCULATION BUTTON
User clicks "Calculate VAT"
→ perform VAT logic
→ log event: vat_calculated
...
📄 INVOICE PREVIEW
User clicks "Preview Invoice"
→ increment invoices_count
→ log event: invoice_previewed
...
⬇️ DOWNLOAD INVOICE
If invoices_count ≤ 5
→ allow download
→ log event: invoice_downloaded
ELSE
→ log event: free_limit_reached
→ show upgrade screen
...
🤖 AI EXPLAIN VAT
User clicks "Why is VAT applied?"
→ log event: ai_explain_clicked
...
💳 UPGRADE FLOW
Show pricing modal
→ log event: upgrade_cta_shown
→ Stripe button click
→ log event: stripe_checkout_clicked
→ on success
→ log event: payment_success

acceptanceCriteria: On first render of the app shell, frontend logs app_opened once per page load.
When country is auto-detected, frontend logs country_detected with metadata containing the country code (e.g., "DE").
When the user proceeds from Transaction Details into Results (VAT calculation), frontend logs vat_calculated once per calculation.
When reverse charge eligibility is evaluated as part of the flow, frontend logs reverse_charge_checked (only when the reverse charge condition is evaluated/true per the app’s logic).
When the user navigates into the invoice preview step, frontend logs invoice_previewed and increments anonymous invoices_count via the backend usage-limits API (when fingerprint is available).

When the user clicks to download the invoice (PDF/other download action), frontend logs invoice_downloaded on success; if blocked by the free limit it logs free_limit_reached and opens the upgrade UI.
When the user clicks to open VAT explanation from Results, frontend logs ai_explain_clicked.
Whenever an upgrade modal/screen is shown due to gating/upsell, frontend logs upgrade_cta_shown.
When the user clicks the Stripe checkout button, frontend logs stripe_checkout_clicked before redirect.
When the payment success page is reached, frontend logs payment_success once.

constraints: Do not rename any of the specified Core Event names; event_name values must match exactly.
Frontend must not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or the immutable hook paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister; do not add additional backend services.
Do not store raw IP addresses or raw user-agent strings in persisted backend state; only store the derived fingerprint and event fields.
nonGoals: Implementing real-time analytics or dashboards using WebSockets/push updates.
Integrating third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Adding external databases (SQL/Postgres/etc.); all persistence must be in canister state.
Adding new payment providers beyond the existing Stripe flow.
